title: Person group
description: Reusable group of persons (e.g. alert recipients of a line), shared by all apps.

plantId.description: Plant the group is responsible for; empty = all plants.

members.description: Person ids (persons@1 `id`); names are never copied (IAM-06). Membership grants no app access. Recipient expansion sends separate personal messages; this is not a Teams team/channel/chat ID.

_tableEditRevision.description: Portal table-editor revision; optional on existing documents.

updatedBy.description: Actor persons.id; no copied display name.

editHistory.description: Append-only table-edit actor, UTC time and changed field values; appended atomically with the row write.
